$description: Trismegistus-mac design tokens: the one source of TrismegistusUI's Tokens.swift (scripts/gen-tokens.py) and of the Penpot token set 'Trismegistus'. Colours written {endfield.<name>} come from endfield-dotfiles/theme/palette.json (read-only). Decided with Martin 2026-11-01 (#33): strict spacing scale, rounding up (6 -> 8, 10 -> 12); Inter and JetBrains Mono, as in the Penpot draft. Inter also has ExtraBold (800) and Black (900), for the B2 sidebar (#65); JetBrains Mono stops at Bold.

radius.$description: #69 (design 13 #a3): tag 3 state tags, tags, key caps; control 4 cards, rows, buttons, fields, avatars, panel rows; s 6 menus; m 8 the section panel; pill 15 the model dropdown. The chat's transcript and composer keep #68's scale until their own redesign: xl the composer block; l code blocks, messages; m the commands chip and the composer's controls. Edge-to-edge bands (headers, rules, the terminal drawer) and the 8 pt identity squares stay square.
